evidence.title: Ethereum EIP-1559 per-block ETH base-fee burn is native ETH supply-context, not directional spot-market Capital Flow
evidence.novelty: New ETH protocol fee-burn block-level source coverage, distinct from previously filed validator withdrawals, Aave liquidations, Optimism bridge and ETF/treasury/venue-trade candidates; no claim of a new qualified scoring source.

search_coverage.source: Ethereum EIP-1559 canonical first-party protocol specification, immutable Git commit
search_coverage.checked: Spec explicitly burns block base fee; does not define spot buy/sell or exchange order execution.

search_coverage.source: Ethereum execution-apis first-party block JSON-RPC schema, immutable Git commit
search_coverage.checked: Block schema includes hash, number, timestamp, gasUsed, baseFeePerGas and finalized/latest block tags; latest can reorganize.

search_coverage.source: Ethereum execution-apis first-party eth_getBlockByHash / eth_getBlockByNumber methods, immutable Git commit
search_coverage.checked: Methods expose the block object; specification example is not a sampled canonical finalized mainnet block.

search_coverage.source: Exact Specialist default collectors and source contracts
search_coverage.checked: Nine default collectors enumerated; no dedicated ETH base-fee-burn collector. Optional JSONL/Glassnode and external market sources can overlap; inventory absence alone does not prove independence.

candidate_contract.stable_machine_readable_first_party: PASS: protocol-defined Ethereum JSON-RPC block object, not a newly captured live dataset
candidate_contract.immutable_event_or_artifact_id: PARTIAL: (chain_id=1, finalized block_hash) is stable after finality; no independently fetched finalized mainnet block or verified chain_id in this run
candidate_contract.economic_entity_btc_eth_scope: PASS ETH native gas fee destruction at protocol level; payer is transaction sender; no BTC scope and no exchange trade counterparty
candidate_contract.metric: ETH base fee burn per block = integer(baseFeePerGas_wei) * integer(gasUsed) / 1e18 ETH; exclude priority tips, blob gas burns and validator withdrawals from this metric
candidate_contract.effective_pit_clock: PARTIAL: block.timestamp in protocol schema, no independently sampled finalized block timestamp
candidate_contract.available_pit_clock: FAIL: original historical first-available time not provided by block timestamp or RPC response; do not backdate first collector receipt
candidate_contract.observed_pit_clock: FAIL: no Anata collector receipt timestamp or append-only observation captured
candidate_contract.independent_nonoverlap: FAIL: no event-lineage comparison with existing market, on-chain, ETH supply or optional external feeds; absence from default collector list is insufficient
candidate_contract.context_vs_spot: CONTEXT_ONLY ETH supply/network-usage observation; burned transaction fees are not independently verified BTC/ETH spot purchases, sales or capital inflows
candidate_contract.live_finalized_sample: NOT_FETCHED; official schema example is illustrative only

missing_reopen_proof: Fetch and independently validate a real finalized Ethereum mainnet block, chain ID, block hash, number, timestamp, gasUsed and baseFeePerGas; document finality/reorg policy
Capture collector-observed time and conservative first-available time in append-only revisions, never retroactively backdate a bootstrap
Independently compare event/block lineage and dependence groups with any existing or optional ETH on-chain/supply sources; avoid double-counting ETH base-fee and blob-fee burns
Demonstrate a separate BTC/ETH spot execution/ownership economic link before any directional Capital Flow classification; otherwise remain context-only
evidence.conclusion: PLATEAU: new first-party protocol source documented with explicit failed PIT and non-overlap gates. No independent directional spot Capital Flow source qualified; no live block sampled.
